members.name: banking77
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which single intent best describes what the customer wants or is asking about?

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a newly received card, or trouble activating it.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age / age requirements to open or use an account; whether children or teens can have one.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or phone/watch wallets, including topping up through them.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, general questions about using ATMs.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: turning it on/off, how it works.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Customer made or received a bank transfer (or transferred money in) but the account balance hasn't changed / money not showing yet.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque or cash but the balance hasn't updated / funds not showing.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a payee/beneficiary, or the beneficiary is not allowed/rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; getting a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; merchants or places that don't accept the card.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card hasn't arrived yet; tracking a card that was sent; card is late.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; when a card will arrive; can it arrive by a date; express delivery.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account, making a new or existing card show in the app, re-adding a card.
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card doesn't work in general: stopped working, broken, or failing repeatedly / at multiple places (not contactless, not a virtual card). A single occasion of the card not working when paying at a shop is declined_card_payment instead.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Customer says a fee/extra amount was charged on a card payment or purchase (transaction-fee complaint tied to using the card to buy something).
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make, framed as 'a payment I don't recognise' (can include a payment with an unfamiliar amount), rather than 'I was charged a fee'.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment/purchase abroad.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM; ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or updating an existing PIN the customer already knows (e.g. 'where can I update my PIN'). Finding/getting/setting the PIN of a new card is get_physical_card instead.
criteria.compromised_card: Suspects someone else is using the card or card details were compromised/hacked (card still in their possession).
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in; using or opening the account from a given country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined/rejected at a shop or online.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined/not authorised.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined/rejected, or the customer is suddenly not allowed to make transfers.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account the customer doesn't recognise or didn't set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, email, phone, account information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees for exchanging currency; extra charges for currency exchange or using the account abroad.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where to see exchange rates, how rates are determined.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra line-item charge or small unknown fee on the statement/app (e.g. 'why was I charged an extra £1', 'why was I charged?') that the customer does not link to a specific card purchase fee, transfer or withdrawal.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or didn't go through; money came back; something went wrong with a transfer.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or supports; holding or receiving money in specific currencies.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get/create a disposable (single-use) virtual card; who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: PIN for a new physical card: where to find the PIN, how to get or set a PIN on a new card, can't see the PIN. (Not about ordering a card; not about changing a known PIN.)
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second card, cards for family members.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card was lost or stolen; reporting a lost/stolen card; found a card after reporting it.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left behind; accessing account/card without phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Getting or ordering a physical/plastic card: how or where to order one, whether one can be ordered or delivered (incl. to/from a given country), wanting a physical card, fees for a new card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/password; resetting the passcode; can't log in.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending / hasn't completed yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A specific transfer the customer made is pending, in progress or stuck — including when they ask how long it will take or why it is taking so long for that transfer.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblocking the PIN/card/account.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from others; how to receive transfers or salary into the account.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Expected refund hasn't appeared on the account/statement yet; still waiting for a refund.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to get a refund for a purchase; how to request a refund; refund process.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment/purchase that had gone through was later cancelled, reversed or returned, or the payment the customer made no longer shows / money came back (e.g. 'my card payment has been cancelled', 'I paid for something but now I don't see it').
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard/credit cards) can be used to top up and which currencies are supported.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card; charged for a card top-up.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque; where to deposit cash.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined or didn't work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how many or how much can be topped up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up went through but was then reverted/cancelled; top-up money disappeared.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card; process for adding money by card; card top-up problems not about fees.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment/transaction was charged twice; duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account from another account/bank; problems transferring money in.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Sent a transfer but the recipient hasn't received it.
criteria.transfer_timing: General or hypothetical questions about how long transfers take / when transferred money becomes available, not about a specific transfer already stuck pending.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Having trouble or failing to verify identity; verification not working; app says not verified.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed, how verification works or how long it takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Questions about showing/verifying the source of funds or where the money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code or verification process for a top-up / top-up card.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card doesn't work or was declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the bank's card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed; why the bank wants personal information.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less or different cash than requested or recorded.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal.
